name: pnp-devproxy-skill-api-emulation
title: Emulate an API used by an agent skill
shortDescription: This sample shows how to use Dev Proxy to emulate a CRUD API that an agent skill interacts with. By emulating the API, you can develop and test your skill without needing access to the real backend.
longDescription: This sample shows how to use Dev Proxy to emulate a CRUD API that an agent skill interacts with. By emulating the API, you can develop and test your skill without needing access to the real backend.
